verdict.rationale: Assigning and routing incoming mail is a fair question for an email inbox platform, so the axis applies. The evidence shows only adjacent features: string labels for conversation state, allow/block lists for filtering senders, and routing webhook events per pod. None of these documents assigning conversations to teammates or rule-based routing of incoming mail to owners.

support.subject: As a team-lead, I can assign conversations to teammates and route incoming mail with rules so ownership is explicit
